data.title: 白面鸮 · 植物标签
data.description: 旧标签被水浸得模糊。她写好新的名称和日期，插回原来的花盆。
data.promptProse: In a climate-controlled greenhouse, Ptilopsis carefully inserts an inscribed acrylic plant marker into a hydroponic seedling tray. Digital calipers, an electronic data slate, and neatly routed irrigation tubes surround the thriving botanical specimens under clean natural daylight.
data.animaCaption: She aligns the white plant label to exact vertical orientation, noting the seedling's growth parameters on her digital clipboard.
